# Health Committees

This folder catalogs professional coordination bodies and steering committees that govern clinical quality development and database oversight within the Danish healthcare system. It includes the central decision-making group for the national inflammatory bowel disease registry and a regional council for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. These organizations are responsible for defining evidence-based quality indicators, conducting clinical audits, and channeling hospital-level feedback into national reporting processes.

## Pages

- [[region-oestdanmarks-sundhedsfaglige-raad-for-mave-tarm-og-leversygdomme|"Region Østdanmarks Sundhedsfaglige Råd for Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygdomme"]] — A regional professional council that coordinates clinical efforts and provides qualitative feedback on data validation for gastrointestinal and liver diseases in Eastern Denmark.
- [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]] — The central steering committee that oversees the national IBD quality database, sets development targets for clinical indicators, and issues recommendations to hospital departments.
